name: Event Radar
description: Your events, trips and deadlines as an agenda or a 3-month timeline. Type or paste lines like "Hackathon 26.10.-27.10." and they are sorted into the plan, with overlaps flagged.
author: AmineChr54

showPast.label: Show past events
showPast.hint: Off hides events once they are over. They stay saved until you delete them.
